title: Server Rack Connections & Ports: Prepositions of Place
description: Describe server rack layouts, patch panel ports, cable management pathways, and peripheral interfaces using accurate prepositions of place.
learning_objectives: Use prepositions of place (in, on, between, behind, into, underneath, above) in datacenter contexts
Differentiate between directional motion (plug into) and stationary position (located in/at)
Avoid common Czenglish spatial transfer errors in hardware descriptions

questions.prompt: Insert the Cat6 ethernet patch cable directly _____ port 24 on switch SW-01.

explanations.correct: 'into' expresses movement from outside to inside an enclosed socket or receptacle.
explanations.wrong_D: 'onto' expresses motion toward an open surface.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'zapojit do portu'. In English, insertion takes 'into' (or 'in'), never *on*.

questions.prompt: The redundant Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) is installed _____ the very bottom of the server rack.

explanations.correct: Fixed vertical locations use 'at': 'at the bottom / at the top'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'in the bottom' is less standard for relative vertical rack height.
explanations.wrong_B: 'on the bottom' refers to resting directly on the floor/base plate.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'dole v racku'. Use 'at the bottom' and 'at the top' for rack positions.

questions.prompt: Route all power cables through the vertical cable organizer _____ the back of the rack enclosure.

explanations.correct: 'at the back of' indicates location at the rear side.
explanations.wrong_B: 'on the back' usually refers to an external surface.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'vzadu v racku'. In English: 'at the back of the rack'.

questions.prompt: The fiber optic patch panel is positioned directly _____ the core aggregation switch.

explanations.correct: 'above' indicates directly higher in rack unit (RU) elevation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'nad přepínačem'. Use 'above' (or 'over') for higher rack positions.

questions.prompt: The hardware security module (HSM) is mounted _____ the storage array and the application server.

explanations.correct: 'between' denotes intermediate position separating two devices.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'mezi diskovým polem a serverem'. Two reference boundaries require 'between'.

questions.prompt: Do not leave any loose screws or tools _____ the server chassis when closing the lid.

explanations.correct: 'inside' denotes within the enclosed internal volume of the chassis.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'uvnitř šasi'. Enclosed spaces take 'inside' or 'in'.

questions.prompt: The hot-swap solid-state drives are accessed directly _____ the front panel of the server.

explanations.correct: 'from the front panel' expresses access point.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'z předního panelu'. English expresses access origin with 'from'.

questions.prompt: The environmental temperature probe is attached _____ the top shelf of row 4.

explanations.correct: Attachment to an object uses the preposition 'to': 'attached to the top shelf'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'připevněno k polici'. English collocation: 'attached TO', never *attached on*.

questions.prompt: Place the external USB recovery drive _____ the technician workbench.

explanations.correct: 'on' designates contact resting on top of a flat horizontal surface.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'na stůl'. Resting on a flat surface takes 'on'.

questions.prompt: The airflow in our hot-aisle containment moves _____ the perforated floor tiles to the ceiling extractors.

explanations.correct: 'up from' accurately describes vertical movement starting from the floor upward.
explanations.wrong_C: 'into' does not capture upward trajectory from a starting level.

questions.cz_learning_point: Datacenter HVAC terminology: Air rises 'up from the floor tiles to the ceiling extractors'.
